title: A Cold War of Spies
description: At the close of WWII, the West views Stalin's government as a threat to democracy, while Stalin sees America as an obstacle in winning the 'hearts and minds' of oppressed people everywhere; Communist leaders try to shut down so-called freedom radios.

title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
description: Explorers uncover one of the largest Incan burial sites at Ancon on the Peruvian coast; it may be proof that the Chacoans were a matriarchal society.

title: Deadly Science
description: People who defy earthly forces and dream of high-flying adventures.

title: Mapping Disaster
description: Exploring the aftermath and impact of disasters such as the Halifax harbor explosion, Hurricane Katrina, the Listeria outbreak of 1985, and the Lake Nyos tragedy.

title: Nintendo 64 Quest
description: Jay visits Game Cycle and is blown away by their huge display of N64 games; but are they willing to wheel and deal at the prices he can afford?

title: I Died... And Came Back
description: An attempt at taking her own life leads to one woman's encounter with an afterlife she never expected; a regular visit to the DMV leads to an out-of-body experience that transports a woman into another dimension.

title: Castle Secrets
description: A magnificent manor is stripped of its former glory; an ethereal French abbey.

title: My Misdiagnosis
description: Frankie is an aesthetician that has excruciating pain in her stomach, leading to many trips to the ER and a diagnosis of IBS; Lynn has a sore throat accompanied by a small lump on her neck and the first doctor dismisses her concerns.

title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
description: From Galileo to Einstein to Hubble, scientists have long grappled with the shape and scale of the universe; as technology expands our view, missing space curvatures and inconsistent data related to Hubble's constant keeps us mystified.

title: Fishing for History
description: When historically low water levels in Texas begin to reveal intentionally sunken ships from World War One, Justin and Mike take a trip to the Lone Star State. What they find is a mystery that predates the war and sends Tobin to a local museum for help.

title: Engineering Evolved
description: Submarines of today help to open up an untouched underwater world below the surface; from diesel subs to modern marvels propelled by nuclear power, witness the evolution of underwater travel.

description: Examining a secret society that dabbles in the occult, laying the groundwork for modern Wiccan and esoteric practices; its studies include alchemy and astral travel.

description: Johnny and Jordyn rely on traditional ghost-hunting techniques as they investigate the Knaut Rhuland House Museum, a historic site renowned for paranormal activity. description: Reinhard Heydrich, the ruthless figurehead behind the Holocaust's planning, wields power through deadly efficiency. His assassination is a dramatic blow to the Nazi elite, but his legacy lives on in the genocide he helps set in motion.
